headline: Losses narrow as cash reserves keep shrinking
summary_short: QuantumScape remains pre-revenue with a Q2 2026 operating loss of $106.1M, an improvement of 14.1% y/y from -$123.6M, and net loss of $98.2M (-$0.16 diluted EPS); cash and cash equivalents alone fell to $132.9M but total cash and marketable securities stood at approximately $859.0M as of June 30, 2026.
summary_long: No product revenue was recognized. Operating loss narrowed y/y as R&D expense fell on lower impairment, depreciation and facility costs, partially offset by higher materials costs and stock-based comp. G&A rose slightly on higher professional-service and office-admin costs. Six-month net loss was $199.0M vs $229.1M a year ago; cash used in operations was funded mainly by non-cash stock comp ($57.8M) and D&A ($28.1M) offsetting the loss. Capex was $14.6M YTD. Total liquidity (cash + marketable securities) was ~$859.0M at quarter-end. In July 2026 (after quarter-end) QuantumScape and PowerCo amended their collaboration program, replacing cost-reimbursement with milestone-based payments capped at $75.4M over two years, versus up to $130.7M under the prior structure. No formal revenue or production guidance was issued.

Tracks the narrower operating loss; interest income also fell as market interest rates declined, partially offsetting the operating improvement.
Follows the narrower net loss, partially offset by a higher weighted-average diluted share count from ongoing at-the-market equity issuance.
